records.source: The Zuzu City Express makes one final trip south, from the icy coast... It's a three day journey!
records.translation: Isang huling biyahe patimog ang Ekspres ng Lungsod ng Zuzu mula sa nagyeyelong baybayin... Tatlong araw ang paglalakbay!

records.source: A young lady peers wistfully out the window.
records.translation: Malungkot na nakatanaw sa bintana ang isang dalaga.

records.source: The movie explores a timeless theme... the conflict between reason and emotion.
records.translation: Sinusuri ng pelikula ang isang walang-kupas na paksa... ang tunggalian ng katwiran at damdamin.

records.source: Will she follow the directions of her rational mind, or the longings of her heart?
records.translation: Susundin ba niya ang katwiran o ang hinahangad ng kaniyang puso?

records.source: The movie ends before we ever find out...
records.translation: Nagtatapos ang pelikula bago pa natin malaman ang sagot...

records.source: The Miracle At Coldstar Ranch
records.translation: Ang Himala sa Rantso ng Coldstar

records.source: Against all odds, a family keeps the spirit of the Winter Star alive...
records.translation: Sa kabila ng lahat, pinananatiling buhay ng isang pamilya ang diwa ng Bituin ng Taglamig...

records.source: 'The Miracle at Coldstar Ranch'
records.translation: “Ang Himala sa Rantso ng Coldstar”

records.source: It's the eve of The Winter Star, and it's been snowing for 3 weeks straight.
records.translation: Bisperas na ng Bituin ng Taglamig, at tatlong linggo nang walang tigil ang pag-ulan ng niyebe.

records.source: The Coldstar family is stranded... getting to town is impossible. Fortunately, the cows have enough hay to get by.
records.translation: Naipit ang pamilyang Coldstar... imposibleng makarating sa bayan. Mabuti na lang at sapat ang dayami ng mga baka.

records.source: ...But the family has run out of food.
records.translation: ...Ngunit naubusan na ng pagkain ang pamilya.

records.source: Still, Papa Coldstar braves the treacherous conditions to cut down the winter star tree...
records.translation: Gayunman, hinarap ni Papa Coldstar ang mapanganib na panahon upang putulin ang puno ng Bituin ng Taglamig...

records.source: In spite of their hunger, the family decorates the tree, keeping the promise of the Winter Star alive.
records.translation: Sa kabila ng kanilang gutom, pinalamutian ng pamilya ang puno at pinanatiling buhay ang pangako ng Bituin ng Taglamig.

records.source: That night, an unusual phenomenon...
records.translation: Nang gabing iyon, isang di-pangkaraniwang pangyayari...

records.source: The next day, Mama Coldstar is astonished to find the tree adorned with cosmic fruit.
records.translation: Kinabukasan, namangha si Mama Coldstar nang makitang napalamutian ng mga kosmikong bunga ang puno.

records.source: 'We believed in the Winter Star, and so we were remembered!'
records.translation: “Naniwala tayo sa Bituin ng Taglamig, kaya naalala tayo!”

records.source: They all shared the Stardrop fruit. Despite its small size, it was the most filling and delicious meal they'd ever had.
records.translation: Pinagsaluhan nilang lahat ang bungang Patak-Bituin. Sa kabila ng maliit nitong sukat, iyon ang pinakanakabubusog at pinakamasarap na pagkaing natikman nila.

records.source: The family is saved, and the spirit of hope is alive and well. The promise of the Winter Star is kept once again...
records.translation: Ligtas na ang pamilya at buhay na buhay ang diwa ng pag-asa. Muli na namang natupad ang pangako ng Bituin ng Taglamig...

records.source: Natural Wonders: Exploring Our Vibrant World
records.translation: Mga Likas na Kababalaghan: Paggalugad sa Masiglang Mundo Natin

records.source: Take a tour through the lands of the Ferngill Republic... from The Fern Islands to Zuzu City, this world is full of life!
records.translation: Maglakbay sa mga lupain ng Republika ng Ferngill... mula sa Kapuluan ng Fern hanggang sa Lungsod ng Zuzu, punô ng buhay ang mundong ito!

records.source: 'Natural Wonders: Exploring Our Vibrant World'
records.translation: “Mga Likas na Kababalaghan: Paggalugad sa Masiglang Mundo Natin”

records.source: The Fern Islands, a tropical paradise 80 miles off the southern coast. The islands formed due to volcanic activity in the region, and are still growing...
records.translation: Ang Kapuluan ng Fern, isang tropikal na paraiso 80 milya mula sa katimugang baybayin. Nabuo ang mga isla dahil sa aktibidad ng bulkan sa rehiyon at patuloy pa ring lumalaki...
